text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Maaaaarvelouuuus☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: From here, the circus enters its second half! You're not satisfied yet, right? You want even more, don’t you!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Show me your smiles! Give me your cheers! Now, let’s go see it! A bigger, more Marvelous show!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Whoa! This circus is way too fun! Seitei Festival is the best! The Uma Girls are amazing! I’ve become a fan!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I’m baaaack☆ Ahaha! So dark, so dark! The backstage of the circus tent, Marvelouuuus★

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Welcome back. ― You finished half of the act 2 minutes and 16 seconds earlier than planned. However, the real performance starts here. Let’s stay focused.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that’s right! From here, it’s grand props—boom! Flashy performances—bang! Heart-pounding Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Indeed. That’s why we must anticipate what kind of accidents may occur, keeping a certain amount of buffer at all times―

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Big trouble! The bike broke down! The one we use to spin around inside the iron cage!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ……Understood. Please guide me there.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: After confirming with the repair staff, it seems it will take 2 hours to arrive and 1 more hour to fix it… therefore―

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Within 3 minutes and 43 seconds, let’s discuss if we can reform this act in another way. Anyone with ideas―

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl D
text_block_list.text: Oh oh! It just popped into my head! Maybe we could combine it with another act! Balancing on balls… no, that might not work…

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl C
text_block_list.text: Th-then! Instead of ball balancing, how about riding a bicycle inside the iron cage? What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ahaha♪ Amazing, amazing! You’re all coming up with such wonderful ideas!

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl C
text_block_list.text: Ehehe… well, we’re all ‘Chanko buddies,’ right? I want to help! As part of the circus!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Maaaarvelouuus☆★☆ Alright, alright! Then let’s just―

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ready? Here we go―! Seeeee-no!

text_block_list.name: Audience A
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!? T-the Uma Girl is… running in circles!!? Like that thing with the bikes spinning around!!!?

text_block_list.name: Audience B
text_block_list.text: Uma Girls are awesome! I’ve seen it on TV, but― seeing it live is insane! So coooool!!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Maaaaarvelouuuus☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Wait, there’s more of them!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Ahahahaha♪ Yay! This is so fun! Ahaha~!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Everyone, thank you for your opinions. Now, I’ll begin preparing for the next act―

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl A
text_block_list.text: B-big problem! Flash’s costume, one of the tightrope girls accidentally wore it and went on stage…!

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl A
text_block_list.text: So, for Flash’s next act… you’ll have to start without your costume…!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ……I see. It’s possible to substitute with another outfit, but it’ll be difficult to express the act fully that way.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: In trouble, pony girl?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I heard the situation. Hmm, I’ve come up with one brilliant idea. Interested?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That said, the chance of failure isn’t low. It’s a trick that requires strong coordination, and we hardly have time to rehearse. Even so, will you do it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let’s do it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Fully aware of the risks, I’ve judged this is worth the challenge. The success we aim for lies beyond it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ――Achieving that is precisely what’s according to plan.

text_block_list.name: Audience C
text_block_list.text: ……………… …………Beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (Haa… stay calm. The hand angle, body angle… exactly as practiced.)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ――How beautiful. But it’s not over yet.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (Next, just follow Fuji’s instructions― toi, toi, toi… we can do it, I know we can.)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now, let’s cast an even greater spell. 3, 2, 1―!

text_block_list.name: Audience C
text_block_list.text: Eh… what…?

text_block_list.name: Audience C
text_block_list.text: Ah!? Wow! The costume…!!!

text_block_list.name: Audience C
text_block_list.text: The Uma Girls are incredible… this isn’t just a school festival performance level anymore…!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (I can clearly see the audience’s smiles. …I’ve worked and made decisions for this very moment. So of course, achieving results is expected, but… fufu.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: This level of excitement wasn’t part of the plan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …Whoa, seriously, that was awesome.
